distinctness_from_form_a: Assignment A uses incremental FCFF/DCF and forward terminal reinvestment; B uses mutually exclusive scale versus IRR, explicit FCFE claims, inverse growth and a no-solution return boundary.

A estimates capital costs and financing/payout policy; B uses certain amortizing APV, a market-weight/time-policy inconsistency, real monitoring cost and a fair-share repurchase capped by dated obligations.
A has comparable valuation and a market-priced delay option; B normalizes a complete cycle and consolidated claim perimeter, then prices abandonment and a separately fundable later upgrade.
A uses a stock acquisition and venture preferred/cap table; B uses a cash acquisition with EPS accretion despite buyer loss, plus LBO debt sweeps and fee/carry-adjusted LP returns.

A tests distress class participation and integrated recommendation; B tests a maturity gap, risk-shift incentives invalidating the offered new-debt price, an operating restriction, delayed collections and a conditional waiver with its own fee and modified covenant.

scoring_review.allocation: Every one of 20 answers contains a visible analytic allocation totaling five points; Q1–Q5 each total 20 and the exam totals 100.
scoring_review.error_carry_forward: Earlier arithmetic errors penalized once; later correct methods using carried values retain credit. Independent conceptual errors remain assessable.
scoring_review.open_answers: Evidence/interpretation and recommendation credit uses explicit criteria and accepts equivalent defensible responses; no requirement to repeat model-answer wording.
scoring_review.feasibility: All numerical tasks are calculator-solvable using accepted methods. Complex domain assumptions are supplied, not required legal/market recall. The time budget is a design choice, not empirically calibrated.

validation.result: Six groups pass: five domains independently reconstruct all twenty numerical parts plus assessment structure. Fractions used for cash/value/claim identities; only simple closed-form IRRs use floating point with root/anchor checks.

Equity funding residual PV confirms both APVs; dated good/bad cash confirms joint option value; all lender, seller, sponsor and LP/GP cash closes; monitoring base minus timing loss and external waiver cost confirms delayed equity value.

Rejects g=r stable terminal boundary; confirms ranking reversal, fee-inclusive carry, nonconstant market debt weight, binding payout cap, physical-versus-market pricing change, anticipated lender underpricing, payable-debt versus covenant-failure distinction, and need for actual covenant amendment.

Balanced HTML nesting, unique IDs, 20 data-points=5 prompts in order and 20 one-to-one data-solution-for mappings. H2 form-b and solutions-b present; 240 minutes, calculator rule, total/domain floors and all 12 accepted chapter remediation links verified.
Fresh checker import/check captured with both stdout and stderr empty; result serializes with allow_nan=False.

Twelve proposed source objects exactly equal existing canonical source records, retaining scoped inspection/checked dates. No new primary-source factual claim or redundant browsing. All three payloads pass trailing-whitespace audit.

resolved_findings.finding: Terminal return comparison could be misread as changing the return on an unchanged historical capital stock while holding NOPAT fixed.
resolved_findings.resolution: Prompt specifies maintained return on new productive capital, fixed first continuing NOPAT and maintained old earnings, exactly matching the taught growth/reinvestment identity.

resolved_findings.finding: Payment-versus-covenant compound assertion required explicit parentheses to test both conditions.
resolved_findings.resolution: Checker tests not(payment-capacity and covenant-failure), then reran all focused groups successfully.

source_reuse.note: Exact canonical records reused within accepted chapter scopes; their previous inspection metadata is preserved rather than relabeled as new browsing.

limits: Ready for independent coordinator review, not author acceptance. Coordinator alone assembles the volume package and changes shared state, sources, verification and hosting.
All scenarios and contractual/tax/risk assumptions are fictional; no current investment recommendation, universal law or actual lender consent is implied.
The reassessment covers all chapter outcomes through a finite set of substantive tasks, not every subtopic. It does not assess every frontier or supply external professional certification.
Specialist checks are numerical, structural and written-content checks; no whole-library build, browser visual/mobile/print QA, independent human exam trial or publication was performed here.
